advisory.title: Crop advice
advisory.tip1_body: Spray before 10 AM or after 4 PM. Strong sun burns the leaves and wastes medicine.
advisory.tip2_body: Rain right after spraying washes the medicine away. Wait for a dry window of at least 4 hours.
advisory.tip3_body: Using the same medicine again and again makes pests resistant. Rotate between different groups.
advisory.footnote: General guidance only. Always confirm with your local agriculture officer.
